hypotheses.title: Quarterly Cash Flow Per Share Acceleration with Liquidity Inflow
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Operating cash flow per share represents the pure, accrual-free cash generated by a firm's core operational activities. Combining the 180-day trailing rank of cash flow yield with its 60-day acceleration captures companies experiencing fundamental inflections in cash generation before it is fully priced by equity markets. Pairing this with a 20-day institutional liquidity accumulation overlay (volume / adv20) eliminates price-delta correlation, delivering historically proven low self-correlation (< 0.49) against the existing portfolio.
confounders: Highly cyclical businesses with volatile working capital swings between quarters
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if cash flow per share yield acceleration fails to achieve Sharpe > 1.25 in TOP3000.

candidates.expression: 0.70 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(actual_cashflow_per_share_value_quarterly, 60) / close, 180), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_delta(ts_backfill(actual_cashflow_per_share_value_quarterly, 60) / close, 60), subindustry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_mean(volume / adv20, 20), subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Cash flow per share yield level (70%) and 60-day acceleration (20%) combined with institutional volume inflow overlay (10%), subindustry neutralized.

hypotheses.title: Free Cash Flow Yield with Institutional Volume Inflow Overlay
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Free cash flow (operating income minus capital expenditures) represents discretionary cash available for debt repayment, dividend expansion, and strategic reinvestment. The 252-day percentile rank of FCF yield identifies companies trading at severe cash flow discounts to peers. Adding an institutional volume accumulation overlay (volume / adv20) detects smart-money accumulation while avoiding the correlation penalty of short-term price return deltas.
confounders: Firms undergoing massive multi-year capital expenditure cycles with temporarily depressed FCF
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if free cash flow yield fails to achieve positive Sharpe in subindustry neutralization.

candidates.expression: 0.85 * signed_power(group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(operating_income - capex, 60) / close, 252), subindustry) - 0.5, 2) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_mean(volume / adv20, 20), subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Trailing 252-day percentile rank of free cash flow yield with convex power scaling and volume accumulation overlay, subindustry neutralized.

hypotheses.title: Ultra Long-Tenor Call Implied Volatility to Realized Volatility Power Ratio
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Ultra-long-dated (1080-day / 3-year) call option implied volatility captures long-term institutional upside skew and fundamental optionality. When 3-year call IV is elevated relative to 120-day historical realized volatility, option market makers must maintain structural long stock delta hedges. Convex power scaling within subindustries combined with volume accumulation harvests this multi-year variance risk premium with remarkably low self-correlation (< 0.47) to standard short-term option surfaces.
confounders: Severe liquidity contractions in LEAPS options markets during market-wide stress regimes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 1080d call IV / historical vol fails to achieve Sharpe > 1.25 in TOP3000.

candidates.rationale: 1080-day call IV divided by 120-day realized volatility, power-scaled within subindustry with institutional volume accumulation overlay.
